# Outside services and API keys

<!-- Generated by `senseai-research api-doc` from `src/senseai_research/integrations.py`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every outside service senseai-research uses, and the environment variable that holds
its key. Keys are set on the research server, never in the app:

- **Railway:** the research service, *Variables* tab. Paste the block at the end into
  *Raw Editor* and fill in the values; Railway redeploys when you save.
- **EC2 box:** `~/senseai/research.env`, then `research-ctl.sh restart`.

The *Settings* tab of the Research page (and `senseai-research settings --check`) shows
which keys are set and tests each one. It never shows a key's value.

| Service | Needed? | Variable | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anthropic (Claude) | Required | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Runs the research assistant in the chat, and reads papers for the library drafting pipeline. |
| Contact email | Recommended | `SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL` | Sent to OpenAlex, Crossref and Unpaywall so they put requests in their faster 'polite' queue and can reach you if something goes wrong. Unpaywall needs it. |
| OpenAlex | Recommended | `OPENALEX_API_KEY` | The main paper search, plus citation counts and journal details used when vetting a paper. |
| Semantic Scholar | Recommended | `S2_API_KEY` | A second paper search, and the reference lists used to cross-check papers. |
| NCBI E-utilities (PubMed) | Recommended | `NCBI_API_KEY` | Searches PubMed. |
| Europe PMC | No key needed | none | Searches Europe PMC and downloads open-access full text, the main source of the passages a biologist checks. |
| Unpaywall | Recommended | `SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL` | Finds a free, legal copy of a paper when Europe PMC does not have it. |
| CORE | Optional | `CORE_API_KEY` | A further source of open-access full text, from university repositories. |
| arXiv | No key needed | none | Preprints. |
| Crossref | No key needed | none | Confirms a DOI is real and matches the paper, and reports retractions and corrections. |
| PubPeer | Optional | `PUBPEER_API_KEY` | Counts public post-publication comments on a paper, a warning sign worth a look. |
| GBIF | No key needed | none | Checks species names and lists the species in a clade. |
| Catalogue of Life (ChecklistBank) | No key needed | none | A second check of species names and synonyms. |
| Wikidata | No key needed | none | Common names for species. |
| IUCN Red List | Optional | `IUCN_API_TOKEN` | Conservation status of each species, shown on the review sheet. |
| Studio connection | Optional | `RESEARCH_PROXY_TOKEN` | A shared secret Studio sends with every request, so the research server can trust the signed-in name Studio forwards. Set the same value on both services. |
| GitHub | Optional | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Opens the pull request on senseai-institute/profiles after a person approves a library change. Use a fine-grained token with Contents and Pull requests (read and write) on that one repository only. |
| Circuits hand-off | Optional | `RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_REPO`, `RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_TOKEN` | Opens a pull request on senseai-circuits with the evidence package a person released (docs/HANDOFF.md). RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_REPO is owner/name, e.g. senseai-institute/circuits; the token needs Contents and Pull requests (read and write) on that repository. Without its own token it uses GITHUB_TOKEN. |
| Amazon S3 | Optional | `RESEARCH_CURATE_S3`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | Copies ledger backups and the download cache to a bucket, so nothing is lost if the server's disk is. |

## Assistant

### Anthropic (Claude)

Runs the research assistant in the chat, and reads papers for the library drafting pipeline.

- **Needed:** Required.
- **Variable:** `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** The chat cannot answer. Everything else (the ledger, impact previews, experiments, approvals) still works.
- **Get a key:** https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys

## Finding papers

### Contact email

Sent to OpenAlex, Crossref and Unpaywall so they put requests in their faster 'polite' queue and can reach you if something goes wrong. Unpaywall needs it.

- **Needed:** Recommended.
- **Variable:** `SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL` (or `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL`), not secret.
- **Without it:** OpenAlex and Crossref answer more slowly, and Unpaywall is skipped when looking for free full text.
- **Get a key:** Any address you read, such as a team inbox.

### OpenAlex

The main paper search, plus citation counts and journal details used when vetting a paper.

- **Needed:** Recommended.
- **Variable:** `OPENALEX_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** Searches still run on OpenAlex's shared allowance, which is smaller and can run out during a long drafting run.
- **Get a key:** https://openalex.org/settings/api (free account)

### Semantic Scholar

A second paper search, and the reference lists used to cross-check papers.

- **Needed:** Recommended.
- **Variable:** `S2_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** Requests share Semantic Scholar's public allowance and are often refused when it is busy, so some searches come back short.
- **Get a key:** https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key-form

### NCBI E-utilities (PubMed)

Searches PubMed.

- **Needed:** Recommended.
- **Variable:** `NCBI_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** PubMed allows 3 requests a second instead of 10, so searches are slower.
- **Get a key:** https://account.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/settings/ (API Key Management)

### Europe PMC

Searches Europe PMC and downloads open-access full text, the main source of the passages a biologist checks.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set.
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

## Full text

### Unpaywall

Finds a free, legal copy of a paper when Europe PMC does not have it.

- **Needed:** Recommended.
- **Variable:** `SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL` (or `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL`), not secret.
- **Without it:** Papers that are only free through Unpaywall stay abstract-only.
- **Get a key:** No key: set SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL (Contact email above).

### CORE

A further source of open-access full text, from university repositories.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `CORE_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** CORE is skipped; Europe PMC and Unpaywall are still tried.
- **Get a key:** https://core.ac.uk/services/api#form (free)

### arXiv

Preprints.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set.
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

## Checking papers

### Crossref

Confirms a DOI is real and matches the paper, and reports retractions and corrections.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set (the contact email makes it faster).
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

### PubPeer

Counts public post-publication comments on a paper, a warning sign worth a look.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `PUBPEER_API_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** The PubPeer check is skipped; retractions are still checked through Crossref.
- **Get a key:** https://pubpeer.com/static/contact (ask for an API key)

## Species names

### GBIF

Checks species names and lists the species in a clade.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set.
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

### Catalogue of Life (ChecklistBank)

A second check of species names and synonyms.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set.
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

### Wikidata

Common names for species.

- **Needed:** No key needed.
- **Without it:** Nothing to set.
- **Get a key:** No key needed.

### IUCN Red List

Conservation status of each species, shown on the review sheet.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `IUCN_API_TOKEN`, secret.
- **Without it:** Conservation status is left for the reviewer to fill in.
- **Get a key:** https://api.iucnredlist.org/users/sign_up

## Connection

### Studio connection

A shared secret Studio sends with every request, so the research server can trust the signed-in name Studio forwards. Set the same value on both services.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `RESEARCH_PROXY_TOKEN`, secret.
- **Without it:** The research server answers only callers on its own machine, so Studio must run beside it. Required when Studio reaches it over a network, as on Railway.
- **Get a key:** Any long random string, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32

## Library changes

### GitHub

Opens the pull request on senseai-institute/profiles after a person approves a library change. Use a fine-grained token with Contents and Pull requests (read and write) on that one repository only.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `GITHUB_TOKEN`, secret.
- **Without it:** Approved changes are saved as a patch and a pull-request text to download, and someone opens the pull request by hand.
- **Get a key:** https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new

### Circuits hand-off

Opens a pull request on senseai-circuits with the evidence package a person released (docs/HANDOFF.md). RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_REPO is owner/name, e.g. senseai-institute/circuits; the token needs Contents and Pull requests (read and write) on that repository. Without its own token it uses GITHUB_TOKEN.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_REPO`, not secret.
- **Variable:** `RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_TOKEN` (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`), secret.
- **Without it:** Released packages are saved on the server and served at /api/research/handoff/{clade}/released for circuits to download.
- **Get a key:** https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new

## Backups

### Amazon S3

Copies ledger backups and the download cache to a bucket, so nothing is lost if the server's disk is.

- **Needed:** Optional.
- **Variable:** `RESEARCH_CURATE_S3`, not secret.
- **Variable:** `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, secret.
- **Variable:** `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, secret.
- **Without it:** Backups stay on the server's own disk.
- **Get a key:** AWS console: an IAM user with read and write on one bucket prefix.

## Copy into Railway's Raw Editor

```
# Assistant
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=

# Finding papers
SENSEAI_CONTACT_EMAIL=
OPENALEX_API_KEY=
S2_API_KEY=
NCBI_API_KEY=

# Full text
CORE_API_KEY=

# Checking papers
PUBPEER_API_KEY=

# Species names
IUCN_API_TOKEN=

# Connection
RESEARCH_PROXY_TOKEN=

# Library changes
GITHUB_TOKEN=
RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_REPO=
RESEARCH_CIRCUITS_TOKEN=

# Backups
RESEARCH_CURATE_S3=
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
```
